definitions.explanation: a person whose profession or vocation is education, especially one who has influence on educational philosophy or practice

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{優|すぐ}れた→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧{教育者|きょういくしゃ}だ。
{教育者|きょういくしゃ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じている→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I feel a responsibility as an educator.

examples.japanese: {多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{教育者|きょういくしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関心|かんしん}→関心：00182_kanshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{寄|よ}せている→寄せる：02329_yoseru⟧。
examples.english: Many educators are taking an interest in this issue.

examples.japanese: {福沢諭吉|ふくざわゆきち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧{教育者|きょういくしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧だ。
examples.english: Fukuzawa Yukichi is one of Japan's most representative educators.

notes:
A formal term for someone devoted to the field of education. Unlike ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧, which refers to a specific teacher, {教育者|きょういくしゃ} describes someone whose identity and life work center on education in a broader sense.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{優|すぐ}れた→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧{教育者|きょういくしゃ}: an outstanding educator
- {教育者|きょういくしゃ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧: one's position as an educator
- {教育者|きょういくしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{養成|ようせい}→養成：14655_yousei⟧: training of educators
- {教育者|きょういくしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{使命|しめい}→使命：11445_shimei⟧: the mission of an educator

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧: teacher; refers to a specific person who teaches, used as both a title and a general term
- ⟦{教師|きょうし}→教師：03029_kyoushi⟧: teacher (more formal than ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧); focuses on the professional role of teaching in a school
- ⟦{指導者|しどうしゃ}→指導者：03062_shidousha⟧: leader or instructor; broader term that includes coaches, mentors, and leaders outside of formal education

FORMS:
⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧ (education) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). The suffix ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ marks a person defined by their role or profession.
